descriptions.zh-Hans: 我吃过波波提后做的纸菜单，特地给蛋奶层下面的肉糜留了位置。
descriptions.en: My paper menu after eating bobotie, with room for the beef beneath its custard top.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在开普敦做的小菜单，记着我那份布丁上的浅沟和蛋奶酱。
descriptions.en: A little Cape Town menu recording the groove and custard in my serving of pudding.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在开普敦折的双面纸签，翻到哪面，邮包就朝哪面。
descriptions.en: A two-sided paper tab I folded in Cape Town, with a mailbag facing each way.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 植物园那次系鞋带之后做的纸剪影，两只纸鞋都绑好了。
descriptions.en: A paper silhouette made after tying my laces at Kirstenbosch; both paper shoes are secure.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在开普敦用干净纸折的小帽子，边缘收得比真帽子牢些。
descriptions.en: A clean-paper hat I folded in Cape Town, with an edge rather firmer than my real brim.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 重拍照片后自制的翻页纸卡，翻开就能找到朝外的包扣。
descriptions.en: My homemade flap card after the second photo; lifting the flap reveals the outward-facing buckle.
